name: workday-rest
description: Reads and writes the full documented Workday REST surface: 907 operations across the 52 independently versioned services Workday's own directory publishes.

risk.read: external Workday REST API read across HCM, Financials, Student and Platform services (HR/PII-adjacent)
risk.write: external Workday REST API mutation across HCM, Financials, Student and Platform services, including HR/PII-adjacent worker, absence, payroll, and financial records; 32 of the 252 write actions are DELETEs that permanently remove Workday records
risk.approval: required for every write action; reverse ETL plan, preview, approval, execute, and every DELETE action is gated as destructive and additionally requires a typed confirmation; reads are bearer-token authenticated
